d7037b2a-874a-4360-8a7b-07f2899152fd.title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun
d7037b2a-874a-4360-8a7b-07f2899152fd.description: Hopeless pushover Iruma Suzuki has found himself in a devil of a predicament... His trashy parents have sold off his soul, and he now has to live and attend school in the Netherworld. But with his unique survival skills and doting demon grandfather’s support, Iruma will surely make it through this hellish experience. He'll just need to subjugate rival classmates, summon familiars, and more, all while never revealing that he's human... Easy as *aleph, bet, gimel*, right?

chapters.title: Reach the Other Side of This Night
In the Palm of Your Hand

c4ca02fb-8378-433b-8049-fbbea5d25cba.title: Haimiya-senpai wa Kowakute Kawaii
c4ca02fb-8378-433b-8049-fbbea5d25cba.description:
At my high school, Haimiya-senpai is feared by all and considered too scary. This is apparently due to her intimidating appearance and blunt way of speaking... and those sparkling piercings! The long, gray wolf-cut hair! Even her Kansai accent is intimidating!!!
But for some reason, this scary senpai treats me kindly...?
As "scary" turns into "cute," this scary (heart-pounding) senpai rom-com begins!

7a2f2f6b-a6a6-4149-879b-3fc2f6916549.title: Oshiete! Galko-chan
7a2f2f6b-a6a6-4149-879b-3fc2f6916549.description: Follow the daily school life of Galko, Otako, and Ojou in this series of comedic short stories. Galko has a tendency to speak rudely, but she's basically friends with everyone. Otako is the quiet loner of the class, but she is good friends with Galko. Ojou speaks her mind freely and naturally.

a4b39b6e-a448-4644-a540-64ceff1d8305.title: Jibaku Shounen: Hanako-kun
a4b39b6e-a448-4644-a540-64ceff1d8305.description:
Ada rumor tentang tujuh misteri atau lebih dikenal dengan "Nana Fushigi" di Akademi Kamome. Salah satunya adalah “Hanako”, hantu yang menghuni toilet wanita bilik ketiga di lantai 3 gedung sekolah lama. Konon, dia akan mengabulkan apa pun harapan orang yang memanggilnya. Di sisi lain, Nene Yashiro, seorang siswi SMA, melibatkan dirinya dengan makhluk supernatural agar harapannya terkabul. Inilah kisah komedi yang menghangatkan hati tentang Hanako, si hantu toilet, dengan gadis penggemar misteri!

f2d8a9aa-3617-4034-91bf-05c494fd7516.title: Ossan Teihen Chiyushi to Manamusume no Henkyou Life ~Chuunen Otoko ga Kaifuku Skill ni Kakusei Shite, Eiyuu e Nariagaru~
f2d8a9aa-3617-4034-91bf-05c494fd7516.altTitle: Old Man, the Low-tier Healer, and the Beloved Daughter's Frontier Life: A Middle-Aged Man Awakens to Healing Skills and Rises to Become a Hero
f2d8a9aa-3617-4034-91bf-05c494fd7516.description: F-rank healer, Reda Dixon (30), is expelled from his party due to his age. Heartbroken, Reda decides on a change of pace by moving to the rural town of Almus. On his journey there, he encounters a blonde-haired girl named Mina, who is dressed in ragged clothes. With no parents in sight, the kind-hearted Reda decides to become her guardian. In Almus, Reda, who starts a new life with the girl, becomes known as "Teacher" by the townspeople, thanks to his unconsciously cheat-level [Healing Magic]! Together, they solve various troubles and deepen their family bonds.

0a4bdf95-dc11-4011-937e-7bdc4dd6e786.title: Mayonaka Heart Tune
0a4bdf95-dc11-4011-937e-7bdc4dd6e786.altTitle: Finding the Girl Behind the Voice.
0a4bdf95-dc11-4011-937e-7bdc4dd6e786.description:
"Late at night, alone on my bed, your voice was the only thing that saved me. I want to talk to you again. There's something I want to say."

Without knowing her real name or face, Yamabuki Arisu, a second-year high school student, was looking for a girl named "Apollo'' who was a livestreamer. However, one day, Arisu gets a clue about Apollo from the broadcast club of the high school where she is going. There were 4 beautiful girls who dreamed of "getting a job related to voice"!! Who is Apollo? What will happen to the dreams of the four people?
___

398cc1ef-1a0b-4e95-a9ee-dbea0b545e97.title: Immortal Days
398cc1ef-1a0b-4e95-a9ee-dbea0b545e97.description: A world where everyone is immortal seems to good to be true, but long ago scientist uncovered the secret to immortality and now everyone can live forever. Those that rejected it just died of disease, war, or old age. Eventually, everyone was immortal, but even still there are always those born a little different. In world where no one can die, why can I?
